ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface across ~75% of the visible area, contrasted with low-intensity (black) pigmentation at the margins and within focal scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central region across both lobes. Low-intensity pigmentation is concentrated at the median notch, the perimeter of the trailing edge, and in distinct linear and circular clusters on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle approximately 52 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 14% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of valleys and peaks ranges from 4 to 18 pixels, creating a highly jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch extending toward the distal tips, characterized by a steady increase in vertical pixel coordinate followed by a downward taper at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of three circular high-contrast ring-like pixel clusters (approx. 8-12 pixels in diameter) on the inner quadrant of the right lobe; additional small high-intensity nodes on the tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe, including a prominent 'X' shaped intersection and parallel diagonal lines.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma manifested as deep-pigmented rake-mark scarring on the right lobe and visible barnacle colonization on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of sessile barnacles protruding beyond the 2D geometric boundary of the fluke tips, creating localized irregular topography.
